decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed pair of two-storey semi-detached one-bedroom dwellinghouses, due to the number of units and restrictive size of the curtilage, would be considered an overdevelopment of the site that would not adequately provide the Council's Housing Standards and would result in substandard living accommodation; and due the size position and appearance of the pair of semi-detached dwellings, the proposal would be considered obtrusive and would detract from the appearance of the streetscene, contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1, H.1.1 and H.1.2 and Revised Deposit (January 2001) policy ENV-B.1.1, H.1.1 and H.4.1.

Condition : 2 - 2/ The proposed off-street parking provision and vehicular access arrangements would fail to meet the Council's Parking Standards, due to the inadequate layout of the parking plan and positioning of the proposed vehicular crossovers. The proposal would therefore result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to adopted UDP policy T.2.5 and UDP Revised Deposit (January 2001) policy T.1.4.
description: DEMOLITION OF EXISTING BUNGALOW AND ERECTION OF TWO SEMI-DETACHED DWELLINGHOUSES WITH ASSOCIATED PARKING
